$comment: Swarm, 4: one task to the PM; the agents hand the work to each other through tasks, dependencies and mentions, and only a decision reaches you.
do: caption:Hand off once|One task to the PM. Then step back.
fill:Message the room…=/task Ship gift cards @pm !
caption:The PM files the work, in order|Each task for the agent who'll do it, waiting on the one before.
wait-text:Test gift cards end to end
caption:Agents wake agents|A team that organizes itself: a filed task or a mention sets the next agent going.

eval:(() => { const c = document.querySelector('[data-testid="thread-conversation"]'); if (!c) return; let n = c; while (n && !/(auto|scroll)/.test(getComputedStyle(n).overflowY)) n = n.parentElement; if (!n) return; const go = () => n.scrollTo({ top: n.scrollHeight, behavior: 'smooth' }); go(); new MutationObserver(go).observe(c, { childList: true, subtree: true }); })()
wait:css=section[aria-label^="Thread"] >> text=the help page can start
click:css=.dv-tab:has-text("Help page: how gift cards work")
wait:css=section[aria-label="Waiting on you"] >> text=Do gift cards expire?
caption:Only a decision reaches you|It waits on you at the top of the board. Everything else keeps moving.
click:css=section[aria-label="Waiting on you"] button[data-board-row]:has-text("Do gift cards expire?")

eval:(() => { const c = document.querySelector('[data-testid="thread-conversation"]'); if (!c) return; let n = c; while (n && !/(auto|scroll)/.test(getComputedStyle(n).overflowY)) n = n.parentElement; if (!n) return; const go = () => n.scrollTo({ top: n.scrollHeight, behavior: 'smooth' }); go(); new MutationObserver(go).observe(c, { childList: true, subtree: true }); })()
fill:Reply in Do gift cards expire?…=They never expire.
caption:Agents file work for each other|The tester finds a bug and files it for the coder.
wait-text:A split payment can leave a negative balance
zoom:text=A split payment can leave a negative balance >> nth=0@1.6
caption:Your attention, only where it's needed|Nothing waits on you while the team works.
